title_zh: 约定系统整理访谈差异再写综合

scenario.label_zh: 约定系统整理访谈差异再写综合
scenario.goal_zh: 承认访谈回答的差异不能被抹平并约定统一编码后再写有范围的综合

context_zh: 两名学生整理已经匿名化的虚构访谈材料，所有回答为课程练习编写。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: The responses are so varied that my summary sounds like three different projects.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: That's useful information. A synthesis doesn't have to pretend everyone agrees.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I was about to keep only the most common answer.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Let's take a systematic approach first: use the same topic labels for each interview.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: And keep a place for answers that don't fit the main pattern?

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Yes. We'll keep those responses in their own column, thereby showing where the interviews differ.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: All right. We'll finish that coding table before writing the synthesis.
